releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.9.8 (CamScanner Engine with Hard Boundary Clamping)
changelog:
✨ CamScanner Zero-Reflow Architecture & Hard Boundary Clamping:
• Zero-Reflow Engine: Neighboring words are 100% untouched. Neighbor words are never cut, shifted, or erased.
• Double-Sided Inpainting Boundary Lock: Erasing old words is strictly clamped between left & right neighbors (minSafeLeft & maxSafeRight) with zero bleed-through into adjacent letters.
• Hard-Limit Auto-Condense: AutoFitFontCondenser guarantees new text never expands beyond available line space.
• 1-Tap Font Override: 4 direct buttons [Arial (Sans)], [Times (Serif)], [Hindi], [Signature] right above the text box.
• Live Typeface Text Field: Input field renders live in the selected font in real-time.
